verdict.rationale: First-party docs show a country parameter that targets results using 2-character country codes in Web Search, and the same parameter in News Search, which also accepts `ALL` for worldwide. Place Search covers location-scoped queries by returning points of interest in a given area. missing for 10: documented language/UI-language parameters, location parameters (e.g., coordinates/city) for localizing web results, independent or hands-on corroboration.
